GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 001 (3 May 47) GA
(SCAPIN - 1655)
APO 500
3 May 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Display of Fireworks on Commemoration Day for Enforcement of New Constitution.
1. Reference is made to C.L.O. No. 3128(PH), dated 25 April 1947, subject as above.
2. There is no objection to the display of fireworks as requested in above listed memorandum provided:
a. Materials to be used are not from stocks over which controls have been established by the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers.
b. Adequate safety precautions and fire prevention measures are taken.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
